ondaatje.name: Michael Ondaatje
ondaatje.primary_move: Time-as-pool. Past arrives inside the present sentence
ondaatje.sentence_shape: Long comma-strung breath + occasional Hemingway landing
ondaatje.body_signature: Implied via object, not directly named
ondaatje.closing_image: Comma the reader carries; door opening

dickey.name: James Dickey
dickey.primary_move: Body-first under stress. Every gesture costs the body something
dickey.closing_image: Aftermath; the body still feeling the violence

king.name: Stephen King
king.primary_move: Ordinary made holy. Working-class register taken seriously
king.closing_image: One small gesture that says everything; no closing thesis

lehane.name: Dennis Lehane
lehane.primary_move: Class as plot engine; revelation discipline
lehane.sentence_shape: Boston vernacular, hard-edged dialogue, fair seeded reveals
lehane.body_signature: Hands as instruments of power or pleading
lehane.closing_image: Moral weight landed on a specific person's body

robinson.name: Marilynne Robinson
robinson.sentence_shape: Long modulated syntax holding theological / ethical weight
robinson.body_signature: Light, water, weather as carriers of inner state
robinson.closing_image: A grace note — small ordinary thing carrying meaning
